entities.summary: Kieffer Bellows is an American professional ice hockey forward who is currently playing for Brynäs IF of the Swedish Hockey League (SHL). He was drafted in the first round of the 2016 NHL entry draft by the New York Islanders. He is the son of former NHL player Brian Bellows.
